arxiv-2103-06170.title: Full-Resilient Memory-Optimum Multi-Party Non-Interactive Key Exchange
arxiv-2103-06170.creator: MAJID SALIMI 1, HAMID MALA 2 , HONORIO MARTIN 3 , AND PEDRO PERIS-LOPEZ. 4
arxiv-2103-06170.description: Abstract Multi-Party Non-Interactive Key Exchange (MP-NIKE) is a fundamental cryptographic primitive in which users register into a key generation centre and receive a public/private key pair each. After that, any subset of these users can compute a shared key without any interaction.

arxiv-2104-07800.title: Towards Robust Neural Retrieval Models with Synthetic Pre-Training
arxiv-2104-07800.creator: Revanth Gangi Reddy, Vikas Yadav, Md Arafat Sultan, Martin Franz, Vittorio Castelli, Heng Ji, Avirup Sil
arxiv-2104-07800.description: Abstract Recent work has shown that commonly available machine reading comprehension (MRC) datasets can be used to train high-performance neural information retrieval (IR) systems. However, the evaluation of neural IR has so far been limited to standard supervised learning settings, where they have outperformed traditional term matching baselines.

arxiv-2201-11179.title: Rotational symmetry of solutions of mean curvature flow coming out of a double cone II
arxiv-2201-11179.creator: Letian Chen
arxiv-2201-11179.description: Abstract . Given a double cone 𝒞 \mathcal{C} with entropy at most two that is symmetric across some hyperplane, we show that any integral Brakke flow coming out of the cone must inherit the reflection symmetry for all time, provided the flow is smooth for a short time.

arxiv-2202-00664.title: Controller confidentiality for nonlinear systems under sensor attacks
arxiv-2202-00664.creator: Michelle S. Chong
arxiv-2202-00664.description: Abstract Controller confidentiality under sensor attacks refers to whether the internal states of the controller can be estimated when the adversary knows the model of the plant and controller, while only having access to sensors, but not the actuators. We show that the controller’s state can be estimated accurately when the nonlinear closed-loop system is detectable.

arxiv-2205-00498.title: CUP: Curriculum Learning based Prompt Tuning for Implicit Event Argument Extraction
arxiv-2205-00498.creator: Jiaju Lin, Qin Chen, Jie Zhou, Jian Jin, Liang He
arxiv-2205-00498.description: Abstract Implicit event argument extraction (EAE) aims to identify arguments that could scatter over the document. Most previous work focuses on learning the direct relations between arguments and the given trigger, while the implicit relations with long-range dependency are not well studied.

arxiv-2305-10717.title: The Pristine Inner Galaxy Survey (PIGS) VII: a discovery of the first inner Galaxy CEMP-r/s star Thanks: Based on observations made with the Very Large Telescope (VLT) 2023 The Pristine Inner Galaxy Survey (PIGS) VII: a discovery of the first inner Galaxy CEMP-r/s star – References
arxiv-2305-10717.creator: L. Mashonkina, A. Arentsen, D. S. Aguado, A. Smogorzhevskii, M. Hampel, A.I Karakas, F. Sestito, N. F. Martin, K. A. Venn, J. I. González Hernández
arxiv-2305-10717.description: Abstract Well-studied very metal-poor (VMP, [Fe/H] < − 2 <-2 ) stars in the inner Galaxy are few in number, and they are of special interest because they are expected to be among the oldest stars in the Milky Way. We present high-resolution spectroscopic follow-up of the carbon-enhanced metal-poor (CEMP) star Pristine_184237.56-260624.

arxiv-2305-12881.title: Building an Invisible Shield for Your Portrait against Deepfakes
arxiv-2305-12881.creator: Jiazhi Guan, Tianshu Hu, Hang Zhou, Zhizhi Guo, Lirui Deng, Chengbin Quan, Errui Ding, Youjian Zhao
arxiv-2305-12881.description: Abstract The issue of detecting deepfakes has garnered significant attention in the research community, with the goal of identifying facial manipulations for abuse prevention. Although recent studies have focused on developing generalized models that can detect various types of deepfakes, their performance is not always be reliable and stable, which poses limitations in real-world applications.

arxiv-2308-05673.title: Algorithms for Encoding and Decoding 3D Hilbert Orderings
arxiv-2308-05673.creator: David Walker
arxiv-2308-05673.description:

[
2
]
which deals with the 2D case.

arxiv-2310-14368.title: The weak Lefschetz property of artinian algebras associated to paths and cycles
arxiv-2310-14368.creator: Hop D. Nguyen, Quang Hoa Tran
arxiv-2310-14368.description: Abstract . Given a base field 𝕜 \Bbbk of characteristic zero, for each graph G G , we associate the artinian algebra A ⁡ ( G ) A(G) defined by the edge ideal of G G and the squares of the variables. We study the weak Lefschetz property of A ⁡ ( G ) A(G) .

arxiv-2402-10270.title: CLusters in the Uv as EngineS (CLUES). II. Sub-kpc scale outflows driven by stellar feedback Facilities: HST(COS), VLT(MUSE). astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , VoigtFit ( Krogager 2018 )
arxiv-2402-10270.creator: Mattia Sirressi, Angela Adamo, Matthew Hayes, Thøger Emil Rivera-Thorsen, Alessandra Aloisi, Arjan Bik, Daniela Calzetti, John Chisholm, Andrew J. Fox, Michele Fumagalli, Kathryn Grasha, Svea Hernandez, Matteo Messa, Shannon Osborne, Göran Östlin, Elena Sabbi, Eva Schinnerer, Linda J. Smith, Christo
arxiv-2402-10270.description: Abstract We analyze the far-ultraviolet (FUV, 1130 Å \rm\AA to 1770 Å \rm\AA restframe) spectroscopy of 20 young ( < < 50 Myr) and massive ( > 10 4 >10^{4} M ⊙ ) star clusters (YSCs) in 11 nearby star-forming galaxies.

arxiv-2405-10291.title: Interaction induced splitting of Dirac monopoles in the topological Thouless pumping of strongly interacting Bosons and SU( N N ) Fermions
arxiv-2405-10291.creator: Hei Lam, Yangqian Yan
arxiv-2405-10291.description: Abstract Motivated by the observation of the breakdown of quantization for the Thouless pump in the presence of strong interaction by ETH [Walter et. al. Nat. Phys. 19, 1471 (2023), Viebahn et. al. arXiv:2308.03756], we study the interplay of strong interaction and topology in the (1+1)-dimensional interacting Rice-Mele model.

arxiv-2407-20553.title: DiffusionCounterfactuals: Inferring High-dimensional Counterfactuals with Guidance of Causal Representations
arxiv-2407-20553.creator: Jiageng Zhu, Hanchen Xie, Jiazhi Li, Wael AbdAlmageed
arxiv-2407-20553.description: Abstract Accurate estimation of counterfactual outcomes in high-dimensional data is crucial for decision-making and understanding causal relationships and intervention outcomes in various domains, including healthcare, economics, and social sciences. However, existing methods often struggle to generate accurate and consistent counterfactuals, particularly when the causal relationships are complex.

arxiv-2409-13023.title: Anticoncentration and state design of random tensor networks
arxiv-2409-13023.creator: Guglielmo Lami, Jacopo De Nardis, Xhek Turkeshi
arxiv-2409-13023.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Guglielmo Lami, Jacopo De Nardis, Xhek Turkeshi. We investigate quantum random tensor network states in which the dimension of the bond scales polynomially with the size of the system N N . Specifically, we examine the delocalization properties of random Matrix Product States (RMPS) in the computational basis by deriving an exact analytical expression for the Inverse Participation Ratio (IPR) of any degree, applicable to both open and closed boundary conditions.

arxiv-2503-14454.title: The Atacama Cosmology Telescope: DR6 Constraints on Extended Cosmological Models
arxiv-2503-14454.creator: Erminia Calabrese, J. Colin Hill, Hidde T. Jense, Adrien La Posta, Irene Abril-Cabezas, Graeme E. Addison, Peter A. R. Ade, Simone Aiola, Tommy Alford, David Alonso, Mandana Amiri, Rui An, Zachary Atkins, Jason E. Austermann, Eleonora Barbavara, Nicola Barbieri, Nicholas Battaglia, Elia Stefano Batt
arxiv-2503-14454.description: Abstract We use new cosmic microwave background (CMB) primary temperature and polarization anisotropy measurements from the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT) Data Release 6 (DR6) to test foundational assumptions of the standard cosmological model, Λ ​ CDM \Lambda\rm{CDM} , and set constraints on extensions to it.

arxiv-2506-17461.title: Projected Normal Distribution: Moment Approximations and Generalizations
arxiv-2506-17461.creator: Daniel Herrera-Esposito, Johannes Burge
arxiv-2506-17461.description: Abstract The projected normal distribution, also known as the angular Gaussian distribution, is obtained by dividing a multivariate normal random variable 𝐱 \mathbf{x} by its norm 𝐱 T ​ 𝐱 \sqrt{\mathbf{x}^{T}\mathbf{x}} . The resulting random variable follows a distribution on the unit sphere.

arxiv-2512-02716.title: Menta: A Small Language Model for On-Device Mental Health Prediction
arxiv-2512-02716.creator: Tianyi Zhang, Xiangyuan Xue , Lingyan Ruan, Shiya Fu, Feng Xia, Simon D’Alfonso, Vassilis Kostakos, Ting Dang, Hong Jia, The University of Melbourne The University of Auckland RMIT University
arxiv-2512-02716.description: Abstract Mental health conditions affect hundreds of millions globally, yet early detection remains limited. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in mental health applications, their size and computational demands hinder practical deployment. Small language models (SLMs) offer a lightweight alternative, but their use for social media–based mental health prediction remains largely underexplored.

arxiv-2601-04270.title: Predictable Gradient Manifolds in Deep Learning: Temporal Path-Length and Intrinsic Rank as a Complexity Regime
arxiv-2601-04270.creator: Anherutowa Calvo
arxiv-2601-04270.description: Abstract Worst-case analyses of first-order optimization treat gradient sequences as adversarial or noisy objects whose complexity scales with the horizon T T and ambient dimension d d . In modern deep learning, however, observed gradient trajectories exhibit strong temporal structure: they can often be predicted from their recent past, and their increments concentrate in a low-dimensional temporal subspace.

arxiv-2601-07778.title: DT-ICU: Towards Explainable Digital Twins for ICU Patient Monitoring via Multi-Modal and Multi-Task Iterative Inference
arxiv-2601-07778.creator: Wen Guo
arxiv-2601-07778.description: Abstract We introduce DT-ICU, a multimodal digital twin framework for continuous risk estimation in intensive care. DT-ICU integrates variable-length clinical time series with static patient information in a unified multitask architecture, enabling predictions to be updated as new observations accumulate over the ICU stay.

arxiv-2603-02061.title: SINR Estimation under Limited Feedback via Online Convex Optimization
arxiv-2603-02061.creator: Lorenzo Maggi, Boris Bonev, Reinhard Wiesmayr, Sebastian Cammerer, Alexander Keller

arxiv-2606-26202.title: Crime reduction through public healthcare: Interpretable machine learning for mental health service impacts in Greater London

pmc-11198094.title: Substance Use in Pregnancy and its Association With Cardiovascular Events
pmc-11198094.creator: Kari Evans, Pensée Wu, Mamas A Mamas, Chase Irwin, Paul Kang, Jordan H Perlow, Michael Foley, Martha Gulati
pmc-11198094.description: BackgroundSubstance use and cardiovascular (CV) events are increasing among pregnant women in the United States, but association between substance use in pregnancy and CV events remains unknown.ObjectivesThe purpose of this study was to examine the association between substance use and acute CV events in pregnancy.

pmc-11338344.title: Abstract 31: Umbilical Cord Blood Derived Macrophages, DUOC-01, Suppress Neuroinflammation by Protecting the Blood Brain Barrier
pmc-11338344.creator: Hyunjung Min, Li Xu, Arjun Saha, Joanne Kurzberg, Anthony Filiano
pmc-11338344.description: IntroductionThe central nervous system (CNS) has a specialized barrier, the blood brain barrier (BBB), that tightly regulates the entry of circulating blood cells and molecules. The BBB is compromised in many neurodegenerative diseases, thus understanding BBB dysfunction is critical to treating neurodegenerative diseases, like multiple sclerosis (MS).

pmc-11460762.title: Endocrine therapy for early breast cancer in the era of oral selective estrogen receptor degraders: challenges and future perspectives
pmc-11460762.creator: Liliana Ascione, Grazia Castellano, Giuseppe Curigliano, Paola Zagami
pmc-11460762.description: Purpose of reviewGrowth and survival of hormone receptor positive breast cancer cells are dependent on circulating hormones (e.g., estrogen and progesterone). Endocrine therapy improved outcomes in both early and advanced hormone receptor positive breast cancer. These treatments include drugs with different mechanisms of action, namely selective estrogen receptor modulators (SERM), aromatase inhibitors, and selective estrogen receptor degraders (SERDs).

pmc-11557019.title: Surface ablation laser surgery: Bibliometric and visualized analysis from 2004 to 2023
pmc-11557019.creator: Jiliang Ning, Lijun Zhang
pmc-11557019.description: Surface ablation laser surgery has resurged in popularity recently because of its safety in correcting myopia and favorable postoperative corneal biomechanical properties. This study aimed to investigate the current focal points and future trends in surface ablation laser surgery over the last 2 decades.

pmc-11675252.title: Healthcare Access and County-Level COVID-19 Mortality: Exploring the Impact of Hospital Proximity and Uninsurance Rates
pmc-11675252.creator: Gabriel A Benavidez, Anja Zgodic, Aleksander Owczarek, Christian Napoli
pmc-11675252.description: Background/Objectives: Many social and environmental factors contribute to the disproportionate burden of COVID-19 mortality. Access to healthcare services has not been thoroughly examined as a factor contributing to COVID-19 mortality. This study examines distance to ERs and ICUs, uninsurance rates, and county-level COVID-19 mortality rates.

pmc-12495794.title: One-stage posterior surgical treatment of the rare thoracolumbar spine process and laminar nucleus with incomplete paralysis: a retrospective study
pmc-12495794.creator: Huijun Zhang, Zenghui Lu, Xiaotong Yue, Jinyu Yan, Xiaobin Yang
pmc-12495794.description: BackgroundThe study was to evaluate the results of the one-stage posterior approach in treating patients with the rare thoracic and lumbar spinous process and vertebral laminae tuberculosis of the spine with incomplete paralysis.Materials and methods21 patients who were treated with bone graft fusion, debridement, spinal canal decompression, and posterior transpedicle internal fixation vie one-stage posterior approach were collected and analyzed.

pmc-12988131.title: Metacognition and diagnostic decision-making: short "blips" of knowledge and the consequences of overconfidence
pmc-12988131.creator: Seok-sung Hong, Lisa K Son, Kyungil Kim
pmc-12988131.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). When making decisions under uncertainty, we rely on the information we currently have. Presumably, the more information we have, the better our decisions turn out to be. What, though, drives our motivation to seek more information? The current research investigated people's confidence judgments in one's current information and their relationship to seeking more information when making diagnoses when presented with a sequence of medical symptoms. In Experiment 1, we explored people’s confidence judgments in relation to the accumulation of information they received.

pmc-12996833.title: Multinomial risk modeling of osteopenia and osteoporosis in Iraqi women: comparative contributions of osteoprotegerin and vitamin D3
pmc-12996833.creator: Manal Jasim Abbood, Amer H Abdullah
pmc-12996833.description: IntroductionVitamin D status is frequently low among Iraqi women, which may limit its discriminatory value for osteopenia (ON) and osteoporosis (OP). We evaluated the vitamin D axis (VD3, DBP, and VDR), osteoprotegerin (OPG), and endocrine regulators (estradiol [E2] and parathyroid hormone [PTH]) in relation to ON/OP risk before and after menopause.

pmc-13093898.title: A Single Dose of a Psychedelic Drug Repairs Prefrontal Cortex Synaptic Physiology in a Mouse Model of Prenatal Alcohol Exposure
pmc-13093898.creator: Tyler G Ekins, Tao Deng, Omar J Ahmed
pmc-13093898.description: BackgroundPrenatal alcohol exposure (PAE) can cause fetal alcohol spectrum disorders (FASDs), which are characterized by neural circuit and behavioral dysfunction due to impaired brain development. At the neural and behavioral levels, PAE is associated with disrupted cortical synaptic transmission and lifelong impairments in learning and cognitive control.

pmc-13194690.title: Physiological, biochemical, and gene expression responses of vetiver grass (Chrysopogon zizanioides) to petroleum hydrocarbon contaminated soil
pmc-13194690.creator: Mahdi Nazari, Hamzeh Amiri, Sasan Mohsenzadeh, Javad Karimi
pmc-13194690.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Petroleum hydrocarbon contamination poses a persistent challenge to soil quality and plant productivity. This study investigated the responses of vetiver grass (Chrysopogon zizanioides) to petroleum hydrocarbon–contaminated soil by integrating physiological, biochemical, and gene expression analyses under controlled pot conditions. Vetiver plants were exposed to increasing levels of total petroleum hydrocarbons (TPH), and plant growth parameters, antioxidant enzyme activities, glutathione dynamics, secondary metabolites, and the expression of GST and PAL genes were evaluated.

pmc-13316395.title: Hyperspectral imaging meets 3D Gaussian Splatting: A novel approach beyond 3D plant morphology
pmc-13316395.creator: Wenzhe Deng, Tingting Wu, Zhichao Ni, Yajie Liu, Hanyue Jia, Qingping Ling
pmc-13316395.description: Accurate acquisition of plant phenotypes is crucial for elucidating plant growth and development, underlying genetic mechanisms, and responses to environmental stimuli. Traditional three-dimensional (3D) phenotyping mainly captures geometric traits such as height, leaf area, and canopy volume, while overlooking physiological and biochemical information.

pmc-13378258.title: Learning pathway determines motor organization and long-term retention of tool use in hornbills
pmc-13378258.creator: Elias Garcia-Pelegrin

pmc-13450587.title: Multimodal skin imaging in chromoblastomycosis: Diagnostic correlation and treatment monitoring during adjunctive fractional carbon dioxide laser therapy
pmc-13450587.creator: Hanhui Nie, Zhenmou Xie, Yiting Fu, Quanhui Zheng, Hongfang Liu, Liyan Xi, Yangxia Chen, Yinghui Liu
pmc-13450587.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). nosis is usually established by direct microscopy, fungal culture, and histopathology; however, noninvasive imaging can provide rapid bedside clues and may help monitor treatment response over time.3, 4, 5, 6, 7 We report a case of long-standing CBM caused by Fonsecaea pedrosoi in which dermoscopy, reflectance confocal microscopy (RCM), and high-frequency ultrasound were used alongside conventional testing for diagnostic correlation and serial follow-up during combined therapy.

pmc-13456071.title: PARP Inhibitors plus Anlotinib as Bridging Therapy for Armored CAR‐T Cells in Ovarian Cancer Enhances Infiltration and Antitumor Efficacy
pmc-13456071.creator: Huayi Li, Minghua Xiang, Qiuyang Xu, Jiahao Liu, Xiaofei Jiao, Wei Mu, Xiaoying Lv, Kangjia Tao, Yu Xu, Dongchen Zhou, Wenjian Gong, Danmei Yan, Yixin Hu, Sen Xu, Bingbing Zhao, Jundong Li, Yongkang Gai, Guang Hu, Li Zhu, Qinglei Gao, Yong Fang
pmc-13456071.description: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)‐T cell therapy is largely ineffective in most solid tumors, partially because of inadequate intratumoral trafficking. Bridging therapy, administered between leukapheresis and CAR‐T cell infusion, offers a distinct opportunity to control the disease and precondition the tumor microenvironment without directly exposing CAR‐T cells to concomitant drugs.

pmc-13471483.title: Artificial intelligence in anaesthesiology: why don’t we have it in our hands after a decade of innovation? A systematic review and perspective
pmc-13471483.creator: Rémi Florquin, Philippe Dony
pmc-13471483.description: BackgroundMachine learning (ML) tools are increasingly integrated into various sectors, including healthcare, where they have demonstrated disruptive potential.While anaesthesia is a specialty historically shaped by technological innovation, the precise clinical impact of ML remains poorly defined. Furthermore, despite a decade of prolific model development, the systematic translation of these computational tools into routine, everyday clinical workflows has stagnated.

pmc-13562691.title: Deciphering glutamine metabolic reprogramming: a novel therapeutic target ALDH18A1 in triple-negative breast cancer
pmc-13562691.creator: Shuixian Li, Shenghan Gao, Jinsong Hu, Shuhan Lyu, Ju Yang, Chenyang Zhang, Chenshuo You, Xiuping Liu, Jigang Wang, Guoyuan Liu

pmc-13575062.title: Gastroenteropancreatic Neuroendocrine Carcinoma (GEP-NEC): An Aggressive Disease Course and Limitations for Personalized Oncology
pmc-13575062.creator: Celine Oanæs, Herish Garresori, Dordi Lea, Marcus T. T. Roalsø, Torjan M. Haslerud, Cato Brede, Kjetil Søreide
pmc-13575062.description: Neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC) is a rare, aggressive malignancy with limited treatment options and poor prognosis. We report a male patient diagnosed with a gastroenteropancreatic (GEP)-NEC with synchronous liver metastasis at the time of surgery who underwent a radical resection attempt. Despite radical-intent surgery followed by adjuvant carboplatin/etoposide, early recurrence developed with progression through multiple subsequent chemotherapy lines.

pmc-13654039.title: EVIORA-HAR: A multimodal dataset for elderly activity recognition and safety-controlled fall detection using wearable inertial sensors and multi-view cameras
pmc-13654039.creator: Iwan Kurnianto Wibowo, Chastine Fatichah, Nanik Suciati
pmc-13654039.description: EVIORA-HAR is a multimodal dataset for human activity recognition and fall detection that combines wearable inertial sensing with multi-view RGB video. The data were collected from 104 participants comprising 71 older adults aged 60–93 years performing activities of daily living and 33 healthy adults aged 18–24 years performing safety-controlled fall scenarios.

pmc-13679870.title: Technological Integration in Triage With AI and Machine Learning Compared With Conventional Triage and Narrative Synthesis of Telehealth for Patient Prioritization in Emergency and Acute Care Settings: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-13679870.creator: Faii O M Ashour, Waqas Sami, Intima Alrimawi, Moattar Raza Rizvi, Majeda M El-Banna, Ivan Steenstra
pmc-13679870.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundConventional triage relies on clinician judgment and limited information available at first contact. AI and machine learning (ML) may improve early risk stratification, whereas tele-triage and patient-facing tools primarily support remote assessment, access, and care routing.ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic and prognostic performance of AI- and ML-assisted triage systems and summarize evidence on tele-triage, workflow, implementation, economic, and equity outcomes.MethodsComparative studies published between January 1, 2010, and December 31, 2025, evaluating AI-, ML-, natural language processing–, telehealth-, or digitally enhanced
